say:0:1611304001:1.text: Digging through the pile, you spot a small chest. Something about it feels familiar.
say:0:1611304001:1.source_cn: 你注意到一个不算起眼的箱子，它静静躺在杜瑞拉的藏品堆中...
say:0:1611304001:1.male: Digging through the pile, you spot a small chest. Something about it feels familiar.
say:0:1611304001:1.female: Digging through the pile, you spot a small chest. Something about it feels familiar.

say:1:1611304002:1.source_cn: 你打开箱子看了看，没错，就是它！

say:2:1611304003:1.text: Four Memory Stars rest at the bottom, with five keepsakes and two magic tomes piled on top.
say:2:1611304003:1.source_cn: 四枚记忆之星整整齐齐地摆在箱子底层，五个小巧精致的纪念...
say:2:1611304003:1.male: Four Memory Stars rest at the bottom, with five keepsakes and two magic tomes piled on top.
say:2:1611304003:1.female: Four Memory Stars rest at the bottom, with five keepsakes and two magic tomes piled on top.

say:3:1611304004:1.text: A faint gleam catches your eye in the corner. You've found the last piece—the medallion.
say:3:1611304004:1.source_cn: 而在角落里，一枚不大但却金光闪闪的纪念币安静地躺着。
say:3:1611304004:1.male: A faint gleam catches your eye in the corner. You've found the last piece—the medallion.
say:3:1611304004:1.female: A faint gleam catches your eye in the corner. You've found the last piece—the medallion.

say:4:1611304005:1.text: You sort through everything and pack it away, when something catches your attention. One of the Memory Stars is empty.
say:4:1611304005:1.source_cn: 你将它们收了起来，但却意外发现一枚曾关押过魔物的记忆之...
say:4:1611304005:1.male: You sort through everything and pack it away, when something catches your attention. One of the Memory Stars is empty.
say:4:1611304005:1.female: You sort through everything and pack it away, when something catches your attention. One of the Memory Stars is empty.

say:5:1611304006:1.text: That's strange. Cranky never mentioned an empty Memory Star... Did Durella find a way to release the Hypofiend inside?
say:5:1611304006:1.source_cn: 奇怪，杜瑞拉抢走它的时候就是空的吗？还是说，她想办法打...
say:5:1611304006:1.male: That's strange. Cranky never mentioned an empty Memory Star... Did Durella find a way to release the Hypofiend inside?
say:5:1611304006:1.female: That's strange. Cranky never mentioned an empty Memory Star... Did Durella find a way to release the Hypofiend inside?

say:6:1611304007:1.source_cn: 你皱了皱眉头，隐约有一种不好的预感。
